name: Orb
description:
From home users to IT administrators, Orb MCP makes it easy to understand what is happening with your internet by connecting Orb Cloud to Claude. Instead of digging through dashboards or trying to interpret network data yourself, you can simply ask questions in everyday language.
Check your current internet quality, explore changes in your Orb Score, investigate latency issues, or find out whether a problem is affecting one device or your entire network, all without leaving the chat.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Orb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Orb to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://panel.orb.net/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Orb MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orb provides these MCP tools: orb_get_measurements, orb_get_summaries, orb_list_device_events, orb_list_orbs, orb_list_space_events, orb_list_spaces, orb_list_speedtests, and orb_trigger_speedtest.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Orb?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Orb in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Orb requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Orb is developed by Orb Forge Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
